notes: One handwritten exercise page. Underlined title Exercice; title text Réalisation régulière d’un polygône. Items a) and b) are followed by an underlined Cor and a final orientation correspondence. No author date or manuscript page number is visible; archive 14 is a comment only, in an unnamed hand.

The setup is an affine Euclidean plane with positive definite metric on its translations. Regularity is expressed by equal side lengths and an inserted equal-angle condition; normalized regularity has written length 1.

Item a requests existence through the cyclotomic equation z^n=1. Item b requests a comparison by similitude or isometry, and then induction of a specified combinatorial isomorphism. These are readings of requested claims; this sheet supplies no proof and no proof was independently carried out for this return.
